rows: A proposition is a picture of a possible state of affairs, sharing logical form with it
Its sense — the state of affairs it depicts
Its logical form — the structure of representation itself
What is a tautology for Wittgenstein?
Senseless (not false) — shows the logic of representation, says nothing about the world
Simple, unalterable constituents of possible facts — deliberately left unspecified
Logic's own form, ethics, aesthetics, the self, the metaphysical
Why does the Tractatus end in silence?
Its own propositions are elucidations, not pictures — the ladder to kick away
